item.title: Presidential Office: "Public demand to reflect lessons of illegal martial law in constitution thwarted by People Power Party opposition, regrettable" (청와대 “불법계엄 교훈 헌법 반영하자는 국민 요구, 국힘 반대로 무산돼 유감”)
item.description:
Regarding the final failure to pass the constitutional amendment bill in the National Assembly plenary session due to opposition from the People Power Party, the Presidential Office stated that "discussions on constitutional amendment, which were promised to the people, must never be halted." (청와대가 헌법개정안(개헌안) 국회 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 반대로 최종 무산된 것과 관련해 “국민께 약속했던 개헌 논의가 결코 중단돼서는 안 된다”는 입장을 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said in a written briefing on the 8th, "We express regret that the plenary session's handling of the constitutional amendment bill ultimately failed due to opposition from lawmakers of the People Power Party." National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik had planned to hold a plenary session that day to hold a revote on the amendment, but after the People Power Party announced it would filibuster all bills, including the constitutional amendment, until the end of the current extraordinary session on the 4th of next month, he declared that "the constitutional amendment bill will not be put on the agenda." This scuttled the push for a national referendum on the constitutional amendment, which was intended to coincide with the June 3 local elections. The constitutional amendment bill had also been tabled for the plenary session the previous day, but the People Power Party's boycott of the vote prevented it from meeting the quorum (approval by more than two-thirds of registered lawmakers), so no vote was held. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 8일 서면브리핑을 내어 “헌법개정안 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 소속 국회의원들의 반대로 끝내 무산된 데 대해 유감을 표한다”며 이렇게 말했다. 우원식 국회의장은 이날 본회의를 열어 개헌안을 재표결할 예정이었으나, 국민의힘이 개헌안을 포함한 모든 법안에 대해 이번 국회 임시회가 끝나는 다음달 4일까지 무제한토론(필리버스터)을 하겠다고 나서자 “헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”고 선언했다. 이로써 6·3 지방선거와 동시에 실시하려던 개헌안 국민 투표 추진은 무산됐다. 개헌안은 전날에도 국회 본회의에 상정됐지만 국민의힘의 표결 불참으로 의결정족수(재적 의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성)가 미달해 표결 자체가 이뤄지지 못했다.)

Spokesperson Kang said, "This constitutional amendment includes incorporating the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble, and strengthening the state's responsibility for balanced regional development and the National Assembly's control over martial law." She added, "It was a public demand to reflect the lessons of the December 3 illegal martial law incident in the constitution, and there was no major disagreement between the ruling and opposition parties." She then indirectly criticized the opposition party, saying, "The people will find it hard to understand why even the minimal constitutional amendment to protect the nation's security and democracy was opposed." (강 대변인은 “이번 개헌안은 헌법 전문에 부마민주항쟁과 5·18 민주화운동 정신을 담고, 국가의 지역균형발전 책임과 계엄에 대한 국회의 통제 권한 강화를 명시하는 내용을 담고 있다”라며 “지난 12·3 불법계엄 사태의 교훈을 헌법에 반영하자는 국민적 요구였으며 여야 간 큰 이견도 없었다”고 했다. 이어 “국민들은 국가의 안위와 민주주의를 지키기 위한 최소한의 개헌마저 반대한 이유를 납득하기 어려우실 것”이라며 야당을 에둘러 비판했다.)

Spokesperson Kang stated, "We request that discussions on constitutional amendment continue with a more responsible attitude in the second half of the National Assembly, keeping the promise to the people." She added, "Constitutional amendment is not just about changing institutions. It should be a new starting point to overcome extreme confrontation and partisan strife, and restore consensus politics, national unity, and social harmony." She further said, "The Presidential Office will continue to unwaveringly push forward discussions on constitutional amendment, a task of the times, together with the people." (강 대변인은 “후반기 국회에 보다 책임 있는 자세로 개헌 논의를 이어가며 국민과의 약속을 지켜주시길 요청드린다”고 말했다. 강 대변인은 “개헌은 단지 제도를 고치는 문제가 아니다. 극한 대립과 정쟁을 넘어 협의 정치와 국민 통합, 사회적 화합을 복원하는 새로운 출발점이 돼야 한다”라며 “청와대는 앞으로도 시대적 과제인 개헌 논의를 국민과 함께 흔들림 없이 추진해 나가겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Getting More Outrageous by the Day... 'Martial Law Troops' Kim Hyun-tae to Run for Incheon Gyeyang-eul, Jeon Han-gil to Launch Party After Local Elections (갈수록 가관…‘계엄군’ 김현태 “인천 계양을 출마”, 전한길 “지선 뒤 창당”)
item.description:
Kim Hyun-tae, former commander of the 707th Special Mission Group under the Republic of Korea Army Special Warfare Command, who is on trial for leading troops to infiltrate the main building of the National Assembly during the December 3 martial law incident, declared his candidacy for the Incheon Gyeyang-eul by-election, vowing to "bring down the Lee Jae-myung regime." Meanwhile, Jeon Han-gil, a far-right YouTuber and former Korean history lecturer who previously announced he would not run in this election, expressed his intention to form a new party after the June 3 local elections. <<> Former Commander Kim held a press conference at the Koreana Hotel in Jung-gu, Seoul, on the 8th, stating, "I officially declare my candidacy for the Incheon Gyeyang-eul National Assembly by-election." Kim added, "I will inherit the spirit of Founding President Syngman Rhee, who blossomed liberal democracy, and continue the spirit of President Park Chung-hee, who lived only for the nation and its people. I will stand against the reckless Lee Jae-myung regime that dreams of a dictatorship and, with only truth and justice in mind for the safety of the people and the nation, write a new history for the Republic of Korea." He also appealed, "I ask the residents of Gyeyang-eul to join me so that I can become the historical protagonist who topples the Lee Jae-myung regime and restores the liberal democratic Republic of Korea." <<> Former Commander Kim is currently on trial without detention on charges of engaging in critical duties for insurrection for leading troops to infiltrate and blockade the main building of the National Assembly during the martial law period. In connection with this, the Ministry of National Defense convened a disciplinary committee in January and dismissed Kim from his post. Since then, Kim has been attending far-right rallies or appearing on YouTube broadcasts alongside Jeon. <<> Jeon, who attended the press conference together, stated that he would support Kim. Jeon said, "I officially declare my support for former Colonel Kim's candidacy in the Incheon Gyeyang-eul by-election on behalf of former President Yoon Suk-yeol and the soldiers currently imprisoned, as well as the soldiers who have devoted their lives to the country and the people, and our reservist men." He further described it as "a contest between Nam-jun Kim, who supports Lee Jae-myung, and former Colonel Hyun-tae Kim, who is anti-Lee Jae-myung." <<> Jeon clarified that he will not run in this election but plans to found a new party after the June 3 local elections. During a broadcast on his own YouTube channel the previous day, Jeon said, "The People Power Party has already severed ties with President Yoon. I, on the other hand, will gather people who uphold President Yoon's values and say 'let's come together' to launch a new party." He added, "I am refraining from that (forming a party) because I don't want to hear the criticism that fielding a candidate who clashes with the People Power Party would 'split the conservative right wing.'" <<> Incheon Gyeyang-eul was President Lee Jae-myung's constituency when he was a member of the National Assembly. With his election as president, this area will hold a by-election alongside the June 3 local elections. It is also a region where former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil served five terms, making it a "Democratic Party stronghold." On March 23, the Democratic Party nominated Kim Nam-jun, former presidential spokesperson and a close aide to President Lee, as its candidate. In response, the People Power Party nominated Shim Wang-seop, chairman of the Environmental Landscape Development Foundation, on April 1. <<> Jeon Gwang-jun Reporter light@hani.co.kr (12·3 비상계엄 당시 병력을 이끌고 국회 본관에 침투한 혐의로 재판을 받고 있는 김현태 전 육군 특수전사령부 707특수임무단장이 “이재명 정권을 무너뜨리겠다”며 인천 계양을 보궐선거 출마를 선언했다. 이번 선거 불출마를 선언한 한국사 강사 출신 극우 성향 유튜버 전한길씨는 6·3 지방선거 뒤 창당 의사를 밝혔다.)

item.title: Namu-ho Docks at Dubai Port… Investigation into Cause of Explosion and Fire Full-Scale (나무호, 두바이항 입항…폭발·화재 원인 규명 본격화)
item.description:
The HMM cargo ship "Namu-ho," which suffered an explosion and fire while anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, docked at Dubai Port in the United Arab Emirates on the 8th, marking the start of a full-scale investigation into the cause of the accident. The government stated that the Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal's on-site investigation is expected to begin as early as 3:00 PM Korean time, but noted it may be flexible depending on local conditions. (호르무즈해협에 정박 중 폭발·화재가 발생한 에이치엠엠(HMM) 화물선 ‘나무호’가 8일 아랍에미리트(UAE) 두바이항에 입항해 사고 원인 규명이 본격화한다. 정부는 이날 해양안전심판원의 현지 조사가 한국시각으로 이르면 오후 3시 시작될 것으로 예상하며, 현지 사정에 따라 유동적이라고 밝혔다.)

The Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal dispatched investigators to the site to determine the cause of the fire. Under the Marine Accident Investigation Act, procedures such as ship inspection, crew interviews, and review of relevant materials will be conducted. The key is to clarify whether the explosion and fire resulted from an external attack or an internal factor. A government official said, "If needed to determine the cause of the accident after the investigation, a trial will proceed based on the investigator's request for a ruling." (해양안전심판원은 화재 원인 규명을 위해 조사관을 현지에 파견했다. 해양사고심판법에 따라 선박 확인과 선원 면담, 관련 자료 조사 등이 이뤄질 예정이다. 폭발과 화재가 외부 공격에 의한 것인지, 내부 요인에 의한 것인지를 밝히는 게 핵심이다. 정부 관계자는 “조사 이후 사고 원인 규명(확정)이 필요한 경우, 사고 조사관의 심판 청구에 따라 심판을 진행하게 된다”고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, at around 8:40 PM on the 4th, an explosion and fire occurred in the engine room of the Namu-ho while it was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates inside the Strait of Hormuz. Initially, the South Korean government leaned towards the possibility of an attack, but National Security Office Director Seo Yong-rak stated on the 6th, "The possibility of an attack was mentioned early on, but after reviewing additional information, it appears uncertain." (앞서, 지난 4일 오후 8시40분께 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호 기관실에서 폭발과 화재가 발생했다. 애초 우리 정부는 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만, 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Another attempt at constitutional amendment in 39 years fails… Speaker Woo Won-shik says, "PPP kicked away both the opportunity and the responsibility" (39년 만 개헌 시도 또 무산…우원식 의장 “국힘, 기회도 책임도 걷어차”)
item.description:
The National Assembly attempted again on the 8th to process the constitutional amendment bill that had failed the previous day due to a lack of quorum for voting, but the bill's submission was thwarted after the People Power Party (PPP) announced it would counter with a filibuster (unlimited debate). The attempt to amend the 39-year-old constitution has once again failed. (국회가 8일 전날 투표 불성립으로 무산된 헌법 개정안(개헌안) 처리를 다시 시도했지만 국민의힘이 필리버스터(무제한 토론)로 맞대응을 예고하면서 개헌안 상정이 불발됐다. 39년 된 헌법을 바꾸려는 시도는 또다시 무산됐다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik declared during the plenary session that day, "I will not submit the constitutional amendment bill," adding, "The procedures for holding a national referendum on the constitutional amendment on June 3 have been suspended as of today." This came in response to the PPP's announcement that morning that it would conduct a filibuster (unlimited debate) on all bills, including the constitutional amendment bill, until the 4th of next month when the extraordinary parliamentary session ends. (우원식 국회의장은 이날 열린 국회 본회의에서 “헌법 개정안을 상정하지 않겠다”며 “오는 6월3일 개헌 국민투표 시행을 위한 절차는 오늘로써 중단됐다”고 선언했다. 이는 이날 오전 국민의힘이 개헌안을 포함한 모든 법안에 국회 임시회가 끝나는 다음달 4일까지 무제한토론(필리버스터)를 하겠다고 나온 것에 따른 것이다.)

Speaker Woo stated, "We couldn't even open the door for constitutional amendment on a bill that could have been easily agreed upon between the ruling and opposition parties, with practically no opposition to its content. I cannot help but express strong regret toward the People Power Party, which has caused the constitutional amendment to fail after 39 years." He further criticized the PPP, saying, "The People Power Party not only kicked away the barely created opportunity for constitutional amendment but also kicked away the responsibility to fulfill the promises made to the people as a party." Speaker Woo was seen wiping away tears as he declared the session adjourned and stepped down from the podium. (우 의장은 “여야 간에 얼마든지 합의가 가능한, 사실상 내용에 반대가 전혀 없는 개헌안을 놓고도 개헌의 문을 열지 못했다”라며 “39년 만에 개헌을 무산시킨 국민의힘에 강력한 유감을 표명하지 않을 수 없다”라고 말했다. 이어 “국민의힘은 가까스로 만든 개헌 기회를 걷어찼을 뿐 아니라 공당으로서 국민께 한 약속을 실천하는 책임도 같이 걷어찬 것”이라고 국민의힘을 비판했다. 우 의장은 산회를 선포하고 연단을 내려오면서 눈물을 훔치기도 했다.)

The constitutional amendment bill, proposed by the six parties excluding the PPP—namely the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—includes provisions such as: stipulating the Busan-Masan Democratic Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the preamble of the constitution; introducing the National Assembly's approval authority over martial law and strengthening the Assembly's request for martial law lift into full lift power; and clarifying the state's duty to resolve regional disparities and promote balanced development. The bill was submitted to the plenary session the previous day, but all PPP lawmakers boycotted the vote, resulting in a quorum not being met and the vote failing. (국민의힘을 뺀 더불어민주당, 조국혁신당, 진보당, 개혁신당, 기본소득당, 사회민주당 등 6개 정당이 발의한 개헌안은 △부마민주항쟁과 5·18민주화운동을 헌법 전문에 명시 △계엄에 대한 국회의 승인권을 도입하고, 국회의 계엄해제요구권을 계엄해제권으로 강화 △국가의 지역 간 격차 해소와 균형발전 의무를 명시 등의 내용을 담고 있다. 전날 본회의에 상정됐으나 국민의힘 의원 전원이 투표에 불참하면서 의결 정족수 미달로 투표가 성립되지 않았다.)

To hold a national referendum on the constitutional amendment concurrently with the June 3 local elections, the amendment bill must pass the National Assembly by the 10th. With the failure to submit the bill on this day, the attempt at constitutional amendment has effectively collapsed. In May 2018, a constitutional amendment bill proposed by then-President Moon Jae-in also failed to pass the National Assembly due to a lack of quorum caused by the boycott of four opposition parties. (개헌에 대한 찬반을 묻는 국민투표를 6·3 지방선거와 함께 실시하려면 오는 10일까지 개헌안이 국회를 통과해야 하는데 이날 개헌안 상정 불발로 개헌 시도는 사실상 무산됐다. 2018년 5월 문재인 당시 대통령이 내놓은 개헌안도 야 4당의 표결 불참에 따른 의결정족수 미달로 투표가 성립되지 않아 국회 본회의 문턱을 넘지 못한 바 있다.)

After the session was adjourned, PPP floor leader Song Eon-seok met with reporters and said, "The National Assembly Speaker unilaterally convened the plenary session without agreement between the negotiating groups, leaving our party no choice but to respond with a filibuster." Floor leader Song also directed sharp criticisms at President Lee Jae-myung, Speaker Woo Won-sik, and the Democratic Party, asking, "Did you have any intention to amend the constitution? Or perhaps you needed a record of the People Power Party opposing it when you pushed the amendment bill through without bipartisan agreement?" He added, "Wasn't there an ulterior motive to frame us as a party that defends martial law and gain an advantageous position in the local elections?" Furthermore, Floor leader Song stated, "We do not fundamentally oppose including the Busan-Masan Uprising and the May 18 Democratization Movement in the constitutional preamble," but added, "Regarding the nation's founding, it should be included in the constitution, and the Saemaul Undong and modernization should also be fully incorporated." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 산회 이후 기자들과 만나 “국회의장이 교섭단체 간 합의 없이 일방적으로 (본회의를) 개최해 우리 당은 할 수 없이 필리버스터로 대응할 수밖에 없던 상태”라고 했다. 송 원내대표는 이재명 대통령, 우원식 의장과 민주당을 향해 “개헌 의지가 있었냐. 혹시 개헌안을 여야 합의 없이 강행하면서 국민의힘이 반대했다는 기록이 필요했던 것 아니냐”며 “계엄 옹호 정당이라는 고약한 프레임 뒤집어씌워서 지방선거에서 유리한 고지를 점하려는 저의가 있었던 것 아니냐”고 날을 세우기도 했다. 아울러 송 원내대표는 “부마항쟁, 5·18민주화운동 등을 헌법 전문 수록에 담는 데 대해 근본적으로 반대하지 않는다”면서도 “건국과 관련해 헌법에 넣어야 하고 새마을운동, 근대화 관련해서도 다 헌법에 포함해야 한다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party and the presidential office attributed the failure to process the constitutional amendment bill to the People Power Party. Deputy spokesperson Deputy Seung-chan of the Democratic Party issued a statement shortly after the session adjourned, saying, "Is it so frightening to enshrine the severance from the December 3 insurrection in the constitution?" and added, "We will achieve the constitutional amendment. We urge the cooperation of the People Power Party." (민주당과 청와대는 개헌안 처리 불발의 책임을 국민의힘으로 돌렸다. 부승찬 민주당 대변인은 산회 직후 입장을 내어 “12·3 내란과의 단절을 헌법에 새기는 것이 그토록 두려운 것이냐”라며 “개헌을 반드시 이뤄내겠다. 국민의힘의 협조를 촉구한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Press Affairs Kang Yu-jung stated at a written briefing that day, "We express regret that the processing of the constitutional amendment bill in the plenary session ultimately failed due to opposition from lawmakers of the People Power Party." She added, "The discussion on constitutional amendment, as promised to the people, must never be halted. We request that the later part of the National Assembly session continue broader discussions on constitutional reform with a more responsible attitude and keep the promises made to the public." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 “헌법개정안 본회의 처리가 국민의힘 소속 국회의원들의 반대로 끝내 무산된 데 대해 유감을 표한다”며 “국민께 약속했던 개헌 논의가 결코 중단되어서는 안 된다. 후반기 국회에 보다 책임 있는 자세로 개헌 논의를 이어가며 국민과의 약속을 지켜주시길 요청드린다”고 말했다.)

There are also voices calling for both parties to take responsibility for the failure to process the constitutional amendment bill. Han Sang-hee, a professor at Konkuk University's Law School and co-chair of the Citizen-Led Constitutional Amendment National Network (Citizen Constitutional Net), expressed regret, saying, "I thought this process (of the phased constitutional amendment bill) was a meaningful step to open the door for constitutional reform, but it has been frustrated." Professor Han pointed out, "The PPP's act of depriving the people of the opportunity to discuss and contemplate the constitutional amendment through a national referendum is anti-democratic," and also criticized the Democratic Party, noting, "There was a lack of effort to pass the amendment bill, gather public support, and sway PPP lawmakers based on that effort." (개헌안 처리 불발에 양당 모두 책임감을 가져야 한다는 목소리도 나온다. 시민주도 헌법개정 전국네트워크(시민개헌넷)의 공동대표를 맡은 한상희 건국대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “개헌의 물꼬를 트기 위한 계기로서 (이번 단계적 개헌안 처리가) 의미가 있는 절차라고 생각했는데 좌절됐다”라고 아쉬움을 표했다. 한 교수는 “국민들이 국민투표를 통해 개헌에 대해 논의하고 고민할 기회를 박탈한 국민의힘의 행위는 반민주적“이라며 민주당을 향해서도 “개헌안을 통과시키려는 노력, 국민들의 지지를 모으고 그 노력을 바탕으로 국민의힘 의원들을 끌어들이려는 노력이 없었다”라고 지적했다.)

Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee and First Lady Make Surprise Visit to Namdaemun Market to Encourage Merchants Affected by Economic Downturn (이 대통령 부부, 남대문시장 깜짝 방문…경기 위축 상인들 격려)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Namdaemun Market in Seoul on the 8th to encourage merchants who have been struggling due to the economic contraction caused by the wars involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. <<> The presidential spokesperson, Ahn Gwi-ryeong, reported that President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung visited Namdaemun Market after attending the 54th Parents' Day ceremony at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, that morning. <<> As the presidential couple appeared, citizens expressed their delight, saying, "We're really lucky today," and "Cheer up." The President exchanged handshakes and high-fives with citizens, asking, "Have you eaten?" and complimented young people holding carnations, saying, "The flowers are very pretty." He also took selfies with foreign tourists visiting Korea. The couple purchased hats, eyeglass straps, and dumplings using Onnuri gift certificates and cash. As the First Lady chose a hat, the President joined in shopping, remarking, "That’s nice. Black is the best." <<> The President inquired about business conditions from the merchants to gauge the on-site situation. Some merchants shared opinions such as, "Although the overall economy is tough, the increase in foreign tourists is bringing back some vitality compared to before," and "We need support to attract more foreign tourists." <<> Following this, the presidential couple had lunch at a pork hock restaurant in Namdaemun Market. The President recalled, "I remember visiting Namdaemun Market when I was preparing for the bar exam and enjoying delicious pork hocks." He also asked the head of the merchants' association, Moon Nam-yeop, who joined the meal, about the market's atmosphere and facility maintenance status. <<> Spokesperson Ahn explained, "This visit was arranged to encourage small business owners facing difficulties due to the economic downturn from the Middle East situation, to hear their voices directly, and to review measures for revitalizing tourism and traditional markets in line with the recent increase in foreign tourists visiting Korea." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 8일 서울 남대문시장을 방문해 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁에 따른 경기 위축으로 어려움을 겪은 상인들을 격려했다.)

item.title: [Rebuttal Report] Regarding <Kim Jong-hyuk: "Within the Party, They Say 'Representative Jang Dong-hyuk Has Almost No Power'... It's a Strange Situation"> ([반론보도] <김종혁 “당내서 ‘장동혁 대표 거의 힘 없다’고 해...이상한 상황”> 관련)
item.description:
On March 27, our newspaper published an article titled <Kim Jong-hyuk: "Within the Party, They Say 'Representative Jang Dong-hyuk Has Almost No Power'... It's a Strange Situation">, which reported that "Regarding the People Power Party's shaky situation due to the Daegu mayoral candidate nomination strife, former People Power Party Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk appeared on YTN Radio's 'Kim Jun-woo's News Frontline' on the 26th and described it as 'a state of anarchy,' citing the lack of visible leadership from People Power Party Representative Jang Dong-hyuk. It also reported that party officials are saying 'it’s already over.'" <<> In response, the People Power Party conveyed that "The opinion of a specific individual cannot be seen as representing the entire party secretariat. Party officials are fulfilling their regular duties and handling local election tasks with trust in the party leadership and commitment to the party." <<> This report is based on a mediation by the Press Arbitration Commission. (본 신문은 지난 3월 27일 <김종혁 “당내서 ‘장동혁 대표 거의 힘 없다’고 해... 이상한 상황”>라는 제목의 기사에서 <대구시장 공천 파동 등으로 휘청이는 국민의힘 상황을 두고 김종혁 전 국민의힘 최고위원이 26일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘김준우의 뉴스정면승부’에 나와 “무정부 상태”라고 표현했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 리더십이 보이지 않는다는 이유에서다. 국민의힘 당직자들도 “이미 끝났다”는 얘기를 한다고도 전했다>고 보도하였습니다. )
